name: Save Our Seas Foundation Small Grants
summary: Annual small grants for short start-up projects on sharks, rays, skates, sawfishes and chimaeras, aimed at early-career scientists, emerging conservation practitioners and community-led initiatives in any country.
reporting: Grantees post a blog each semester and submit a final report on the SOSF template, including a financial summary, within 90 days of the project end date.

status.quote: Stage I: is CLOSED and will open again mid-March 2027

applicant_types.quote: dedicated to early-career scientists worldwide (within five years of a degree being awarded), emerging conservation practitioners, and community-led initiatives

geography.quote: The Small Grant is designed for short (up to 18 months) and small projects in any country

access.quote: The Small Grant application process consists of a two-stage online application

window.quote: Stage I: is CLOSED and will open again mid-March 2027
